facts.fact: The secretary-general of the Cubango provincial government said its SIGDA project, approved on 18 December 2025, includes specific solutions to assure internet access in all the province's municipal administrations, against weak internet and electricity coverage in some municipalities such as Mavengue; no number of administrations is given.
facts.system: internet access for municipal administrations under the SIGDA project

facts.fact: The Cubango provincial government approved on 18 December 2025 a project that provides for internet access in all its municipal administrations, with implementation to start in January 2026 and six months allowed to full operation; the connection is planned, not reported as delivered.
